descriptionChirho: A day as a general unit of time, a specific calendar day, or a period/era marked by events (the day of X, in those days, today).
The daylight portion of a 24-hour cycle, as opposed to night; daytime or midday.
The span of someone's life or reign, expressed as 'his days,' 'our days,' 'your days,' 'their days,' referring to one's allotted time of living.
Comparative temporal expression using the preposition ke- (like/as), comparing a situation to a particular day or days.
The dual form indicating a period of exactly two days.
